vod._why: Twitch VODs: long, slow, chat is the best signal; first minutes are 'starting soon'/PS5 menus

youtube._why: YouTube: no chat, often already edited (denser, faster); skip intros/outros and sponsor reads; sections ~100 s so Creator Rewards cuts (61-90 s) fit

style_note: box = @clippingwnl reference: facecam top ~41% full width, sentence-case headline in a white box on the seam, no burned captions, no watermark. For the old look: style/title_style 'outline', captions true, watermark '@cogiclips5'.
